description:
Tingloy lagoon beach atmosphere (binaural, please use headset for 3D effects). 
I made this recording in the morning, at a small beach, near a place called The Lagoon by the inhabitants, on the western coast of Tingloy, a small island in Batangas Province, in the Philippines. 
One can hear gentle waves and wavelets lapping the shore, and some birds in the background. 
Recorded in August 2025 with a Zoom H5studio and Ohrwurm 3D binaural microphones. 
Fade in/out and high pass filter at 60Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity. 
(If you want to use this sound as a mono audio file, you may have to delete one channel to avoid phase issues).
